narratives.Problem: Merged PR #2589 closed issues #2575 and #2576 but left their shared xBRIEF active, running, and structurally invalid because plan.items was absent. That makes the repository-wide vBRIEF validation gate fail on every downstream branch.
narratives.Change: Repair the missing required empty item list, then reconcile the merged story through the canonical post-merge cohort finalizer so it becomes a valid completed lifecycle record.
narratives.Scope: In scope: the shared #2575/#2576 lifecycle record, focused post-merge sweep verification, repository validation, release notes, and issue #2598 closure. Out of scope: changing production lifecycle behavior or bundling either current feature PR.
narratives.Impact: Moves one xBRIEF from active to completed. PR #2597 benefits from a green base validation gate. PR #2599 must drop its temporary edit to the same active file when rebased.
narratives.Risks: A hand-authored move could bypass lifecycle metadata or lose the merged scope record; using swarm:finalize-cohort avoids that risk. The remaining integration risk is a predictable delete/modify conflict in PR #2599.
narratives.Approach: Reproduce the validation failure, verify PR #2589 resolves both closing issues to one story, add the schema-required empty items field, run the canonical finalizer without its own commit/PR side effects, and validate the terminal result.
narratives.Alternatives: Folding the repair into PR #2599 would broaden that bug-fix scope and leave PR #2597 blocked. Changing lifecycle production code is unnecessary because the finalizer resolves the merged cohort correctly when invoked.
narratives.Dependencies: PR #2589 must be merged and its closing references to #2575 and #2576 must remain available through GitHub.

references.title: Issue #2598: merged #2589 leaves invalid active scope
